segments.comment: A blindfolded cavewoman applies a wished glaive at the floor two squares east. The spot is in range but unseen and holds no monster, invisible-monster or statue glyph, so apply.c use_pole() prints You(cant_see_spot): "You won't hit anything if you can't see that spot." Seed, date, character, polearm and target chosen independently of the batch 14 pilot.
